decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up just +0.2% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Despite having $789 in cash and 3 open slots, none of today's top-scoring candidates showed the full four-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD crossover, price/SMA-20, and volume surge) needed for a high-conviction buy, so we held cash rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices were essentially unchanged today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 each up roughly 0.2%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode without a strong catalyst pushing sentiment in either direction. Several growth and semiconductor names on the screener showed bullish technical setups (MACD crossovers, RSI in the healthy 55-70 range), but the absence of confirming volume surges means the moves may lack broader institutional participation. With no major economic data or earnings catalysts driving the tape, this looks like consolidation after recent gains rather than a new trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克及標普500指數皆僅微升約0.2%，顯示投資人在缺乏明確催化因素下採取觀望態度。篩選名單中部分成長股與半導體股呈現技術面偏多訊號（如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於55至70的健康區間），但由於未見成交量明顯放大配合，這些漲勢是否有法人資金真正進場仍待觀察。在沒有重大經濟數據或財報消息帶動下，今日盤勢較像是近期漲勢後的整理階段，而非新趨勢的展開。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash you keep on hand rather than investing immediately, so you can act when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's candidates looked decent but lacked full confirmation (like a volume surge), so holding cash instead of forcing a buy preserves flexibility for a better setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資人保留現金而非立即全數投入，以便在真正出現強勢機會時有資金可以進場。今日的候選股票雖有部分利多訊號，但缺乏成交量放大等完整確認，因此選擇持有現金、不勉強進場，為日後更佳的進場時機保留彈性。
